summary: CSS can change how links and images look. Links get a color and underline style, and images can be switched from inline to block.
notes: An is inline by default, so text can sit next to it. display: block gives it its own line.
The a selector styles every link on the page.
text-decoration-thickness makes the underline thicker without removing it.
pitfall: Removing the underline with text-decoration: none. Links then look like regular text, and people miss them.
